scope: Blind separate-agent authored labels; NOT human gold. Question-heldout, shared frozen corpus. Conflicting premises are answerable corrections, not source-source conflicts. No answer generation qualification.
policy: BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75 Unicode lowercase word tokens, top3 deterministic id ties. Per method choose threshold on calibration only to maximize balanced answerability accuracy; ties prefer larger threshold. Score >= threshold predicts evidence available. Freeze threshold before computing heldout metrics. This is retrieval evidence-availability classification, not calibrated correctness or generated-answer abstention.
